description: React Context for authentication state management, including user info, roles, authentication status, and related functions such as login, logout, and session refresh. Defines an AuthContext and AuthProvider component to provide authentication state to the component tree.

methods.name: AuthProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component providing authentication context, managing user state, roles, loading/error states, and functions to login, logout, and refresh session.

methods.name: loadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronous callback to fetch and set user profile and roles, updating loading and error states accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Asynchronous function to authenticate user with provided credentials, setting user and roles state upon success and handling errors.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Function to invoke logout process and clear user and roles state.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronous function to refresh the authentication token/session and reload user profile, handling failures by logging out.
